title: Five decisions to make before a campaign goes live
hook: The best time to decide when to cut an ad is before it goes live.
caption:
The best time to decide when to cut an ad is before it goes live.

After launch, everyone reads the numbers their own way, and the review turns into a debate.

Five decisions settle it in advance: what the ad is testing, what it is compared with, the one number that judges it, how long it runs, and what happens if it wins or loses.

The last slide is a card you can fill in for each campaign. Save it.

Want help setting these rules for your account? Link in bio. Follow @galvor.ai.
